name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A plugin that tunes how well your AI coding assistant remembers past work and follows security best practices, so it wastes less time and makes fewer risky mistakes.
buyer: The engineering manager at a 10-20 person startup who has several developers on paid AI coding subscriptions and wants to cut wasted tokens and repeated mistakes across the team.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it across the team's Claude Code setups so every engineer's agent shares the same security guardrails, instead of each person configuring their own.
A solo developer building a paid SaaS uses the memory layer so the agent stops re-learning the same architecture decisions every new session.
An engineering consultancy standardizes this on every client engagement as a way to demonstrably reduce AI-assisted development costs it can point to in proposals.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid onboarding/setup calls that configure ECC for a company's specific stack and internal security policies.
Sell a hosted dashboard (already hinted at with ecc.tools pricing) that tracks token savings and security incidents caught across a team.

steal_this: Build a one-page 'before/after token cost' calculator that estimates how much a team would save adopting ECC, and use it as a lead magnet for the paid tier.
